chars.W: WIFE: a young Moroccan woman wearing an emerald green satin kaftan with gold embroidery and a cream headscarf, gold bracelets.
chars.H: HUSBAND: a young Moroccan barber (27) wearing a crisp white shirt with rolled sleeves, black trousers, a neat black beard, a silver watch.
chars.P: PARENTS: an older Moroccan man in a beige djellaba with a red fez and an older woman in a lilac djellaba and white headscarf.

scenes.name: n1.png
scenes.scene: In a modern Moroccan apartment kitchen in the evening, the WIFE pushes an empty dinner plate away across the counter and turns her face away with a cold, sulking, stubborn expression, arms crossed; cold stove behind her with no pots. Seen from the kitchen doorway as if by her husband, head-to-waist framing, face clearly visible.

scenes.name: n2.png
scenes.scene: In the apartment living room, the WIFE angrily taps a blank paper folder of apartment documents on the coffee table, glaring at the HUSBAND; the HUSBAND sits holding a set of apartment keys, shaking his head no. Medium shot, both faces visible, tense but slightly comic.

scenes.name: n3.png
scenes.scene: In a Moroccan apartment hallway, the HUSBAND stands in front of a firmly closed bedroom door holding a red gift box with a bow and a bouquet of flowers, smiling hopefully and knocking gently. Head-to-waist framing, face visible.

scenes.name: n4.png
scenes.scene: Inside a small modern Moroccan barbershop, the HUSBAND sits on a waiting bench eating a street sandwich wrapped in paper next to two young barber workers in black aprons who also eat sandwiches; the HUSBAND looks tired and sad. Medium shot, faces visible.

scenes.name: n5.png
scenes.scene: In a traditional Moroccan salon with low sofas and a tea tray, the HUSBAND sits with open hands complaining to the older PARENTS of his wife; the old father leans forward raising a warning finger with a serious face, the mother looks worried. Medium shot, faces visible, suspense mood.
